title: Death-note
description: This project adds a death note with a custom texture and when opened it lets you chose a cause of death(which prints in the chat)
body:
Death Note Book — Power Over Life and Death

Ever wanted to roleplay as a supernatural force on your server? The Death Note Book mod brings the concept of a cursed, all-powerful tome to Minecraft. Operators can use this mysterious book to influence the fate of players in creative and dramatic ways.

Features:

🔮 Cursed Book Interface — Right-click to open a sleek two-page UI that feels like forbidden knowledge
⚰️ Multiple Death Causes — Choose how fate strikes: lava, fall damage, explosion, slain by magic, or fully custom messages
🎭 Fake Mode — Send dramatic messages without actually dealing damage (perfect for roleplay servers)
📊 Fully Logged — Every use is recorded to logs/deathnote.log for server audits and intrigue
⏱️ Balanced Cooldown — 30-second cooldown prevents spam while keeping action flowing
🛠️ Easy Crafting — Assemble with books, feathers, and ink sacs

Installation:
Both server and client mods are required. Drop the mod into your mods folder on Fabric 26.2. For full details on configuration and usage, check out the GitHub repository https://github.com/Aldur13/Death-note.
